Clinch night window: Midtown, Thu 10 Jun 2027

Live. The Knicks won Game 6 and the title; the final buzzer was at 11:12 pm. The window runs to about 4:12 am. The busiest hour is expected to be the first after the buzzer.

Why this night: On past clinch and title nights, Midtown saw a sharp rise in injury calls 2 of 6 times. On an ordinary night that happens about 3 times in 100. (Our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records, 2025–2026: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj.)

Tonight:
- Weather (NWS): clear, about 72°F; no alert.
- Other crowds (NYC permitted events): no parade or street event in precincts 14 or 18.
- Official advisories (local press, read by hand): no official outdoor watch party.

This is a time to be ready, not a forecast that anything will happen. It is not an emergency service: anyone hurt or in danger, call 911.
